# @agimon-ai/doompi-sandbox

Package-owned guidance for Container sandbox for DoomPi launches: the agent, extensions, and tools run inside Docker or Podman while the terminal stays on the host

## How to use

- [Use Sandbox](./src/prompts/doompi-use-sandbox/SKILL.md): Run the package command and follow its package-specific usage guidance.

## Resources

- [Package README](./README.md): Installation, development commands, Pi entrypoint, and extension-specific usage.
